from z3 import *
n = 12
Row = ArraySort(IntSort(), IntSort())
x = Array('x', IntSort(), Row)
s = Solver()
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        s.add(And(x[i][j] >= 0, x[i][j] < n))
for i in range(n):
    s.add(x[i][i] == i)
for i in range(n):
    s.add(Distinct([x[i][j] for j in range(n)]))
for j in range(n):
    s.add(Distinct([x[i][j] for i in range(n)]))
i_sym, j_sym = Ints('i j')
s.add(ForAll([i_sym, j_sym], Implies(And(i_sym >= 0, i_sym < n, j_sym >= 0, j_sym < n), x[x[i_sym][j_sym]][x[j_sym][i_sym]] == i_sym)))
print(s.check())
